fit_3factor.note: MIXED — fit indices DISAGREE (some acceptable/good, at least one poor); report all, do NOT auto-fail on one index (Marsh 2004). NOT the same as uniformly poor — fit != truth; cutoffs are benchmarks, not golden rules.

fit_1factor.note: POOR fit: every conventional index rejects the model — fit != truth; cutoffs are benchmarks, not golden rules.

3factor.note: MIXED — fit indices DISAGREE (some acceptable/good, at least one poor); report all, do NOT auto-fail on one index (Marsh 2004). NOT the same as uniformly poor — fit != truth; cutoffs are benchmarks, not golden rules.

1factor.note: POOR fit: every conventional index rejects the model — fit != truth; cutoffs are benchmarks, not golden rules.

comparison.note: data prefer model 3factor; delta-CFI=+0.254. A model winning a comparison is 'less wrong than the alternative tested', not 'true'.

efa.note: Glorfeld-95 parallel analysis is the primary rule; Kaiser>1 over-extracts. Dimensionality, not validity.

reliability.note: omega preferred when loadings differ; alpha is a lower bound. Reliability != validity.
